breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”

Neurologic deficits depend on the affected segments and the functioning of the residual spinal cord. Clinical presentation includes varying degrees of motor weakness (associated with deformities of the lower limbs) and neurogenic bladder dysfunction.

master.definition_en: A slow growing, locally invasive neoplasm arising from tooth-forming tissues. It most often grows intraosseously in the mandible and less frequently in the maxilla. In a minority of cases it grows extraosseously in the gingiva. It is characterized by the presence of a fibrous stroma, epithelial cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, and amyloid material which is often calcified. Small tumors may be successfully treated with enucleation. Local resection is usually required for larger tumors. Recurrences have been reported in a minority of cases.

master.definition_en: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy (OPDM) is a rare, adult-onset hereditary muscle disease. People with OPDM present with progressive eye and throat (pharyngeal) problems and involvement of the muscles of the lower legs and arms. Symptoms may include eyelid drooping (ptosis), swallowing difficulty, hoarse and nasal voice, leg and arm weakness, as well as muscle wasting in the face and in the legs and arms. Many people have respiratory problems due to respiratory muscle weakness. In rare cases, there is also hearing loss, as well as severe weakness in muscles of the forearms and thighs. As the disease progresses, other muscles may be affected. A blood exam may show an increased creatine kinase level and an abnormal EMG. Inheritance may be autosomal dominant or autosomal recessive. The specific cause is still unknown.

curated.name_zh: 局灶节段性肾小球硬化
curated.category: 难治性肾小球足细胞病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 肾脏滤过单元中部分肾小球发生局部“瘢痕化硬化”，导致大量蛋白尿漏出并呈不可逆进行性破坏; 2) FSGS是成人和儿童原发性肾病综合征中最难治的类型之一，约40%–60%的持续大量蛋白尿患者在5–10年内进展至尿毒症; 3) 即使接受肾移植，原发性FSGS在移植肾中的复发率仍高达30%–50%，随时可能再次毁掉新肾脏。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 治疗难点在于必须先精确区分“原发免疫性、继发高滤过性（肥胖/单肾）还是单基因遗传性”——遗传性FSGS对激素免疫抑制完全无效；对于非遗传型，通过激素/他克莫司联合RAS阻断及SGLT2抑制剂可控制部分患者；2023–2024年斯帕森坦（DUPLEX 3期）与针对APOL1基因型的精准小分子Inaxaplin为难治性FSGS带来重大新希望。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE将FSGS合并计入慢性肾脏病（CKD）；未达蛋白尿缓解者10年进展至终末期肾病比例高达50%左右

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国单列死亡登记；国内肾活检登记显示FSGS约占原发性肾小球疾病的5%–10%，是儿童及青壮年激素耐药型肾病综合征的首要病理类型

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年FSGS迎来自基因精准靶向药问世的突破：1) 发表在NEJM的2a期试验证实，全球首个口服APOL1离子通道抑制剂Inaxaplin能使携带APOL1高风险等位基因的难治性FSGS患者第13周蛋白尿大幅下降47.6%，已进入2/3期关键试验（AMPLITUDE）; 2) 迄今规模最大的FSGS 3期试验DUPLEX（108周数据发表于NEJM 2023）证实斯帕森坦降低蛋白尿达完全/部分缓解比例显著优于厄贝沙坦; 3) TRPC5/6抑制剂与抗Nephrin靶向研究正加速转化。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尚无正式获批专门针对FSGS的对因特效药; 2) 导致原发FSGS及移植后复发的血液“循环渗透因子”至今尚未完全锁定; 3) 临床缺乏快速区分原发性与继发性FSGS的无创病理替代指标。

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: Neuronal brain tumors are an uncommon group of central nervous system tumors that arise from cells with neuronal differentiation. These tumors may be purely neuronal in origin or have mixed neuronal and glial components, which comprise a subset of glioneuronal tumors.
